adjustments.name: the two nuts at the tab of each of the four bed posts (set once at assembly)
x switch: its screws run in slots in the Y plate's land
y switch: its mount slides along the rail on two T-nuts
z belt: tensioner idler bolt in a slot
x belt: idler plate slides on its T-nuts, M3 jack screw
y belts: motor mounts slide on their T-nuts, M3 jack screws

lead_screws.lead_deviation: 0.1 mm / 300 mm (Elesa GN 103, igus DryLin TR; generic T8 unknown)
lead_screws.basis: scaled linearly from docs/PRINTER_V8.md trade-study figures for layout (d): a hand estimate, not computed
